encoding.land: value = 1 + metres above sea level * heightScale, clamped to 255

source.title: Terrain Tiles (Terrarium), Mapzen / AWS Open Data
source.attribution: Elevation data from Mapzen Terrain Tiles: USGS 3DEP, SRTM, ETOPO1 and other public sources.
source.modifications: Sampled to a 100 m grid in the game's local frame and reduced to a land silhouette with coarse height. Within 450 m of the city's surveyed shoreline, on either side of it, ground within 250 m of water is left out.
source.limitations: A silhouette for distant context only: no buildings, roads or imagery, and no claim to shoreline accuracy.
